content.value: . Air flows over a flat plate at a constant velocity of 5 m/s and an atmosphere condition of 1 atm pressure and at a temperature of $2 8 ^ { \circ } C$ , the plate is heated to a constant temperature of $9 5 ^ { \circ } C$ . Starting at a distance of 12 cm from the leading edge, determine the total heat transfer from the plate at a point 40 cm from the leading edge.
